'''Consommé''' ({{IPA|fr|kɔ̃sɔme|lang}} ({{pronunciation|consommé.ogg}}) is a type of clear [[soup]] made from richly flavoured [[Stock (food)|stock]] or [[broth]] that has been clarified, a process that traditionally uses [[egg white]]s to remove fat and sediment. A later technique for clarification employs [[gelatin]] filtration. Consommés are most commonly made from beef or veal, but chicken, fish and [[Game (hunting)|game]] variants are recognised in French cuisine. They may be served on their own – hot or chilled – or be used as the basis of many soups, sauces and stews.
